datasets.displayName: The dollar indexes of the day
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT s.signal_date, s.signal_code, s.signal_name, CASE WHEN s.is_yes THEN 'Strong' ELSE 'Weak' END AS dollar_state, s.band_code AS dollar_band, CASE s.signal_code WHEN 'dollar_index' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS index_order, s.measured_value AS index_level, s.threshold_value AS average_200, s.reason_text FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.signal_code IN ('dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index') ORDER BY index_order

datasets.name: ds_currency_grid
datasets.displayName: Currencies against the US dollar and the Australian dollar
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), names AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 1), ('EUR', 'Euro', 2), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 3), ('GBP', 'British pound', 4), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 5), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 6), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 7), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 8), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 9), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 10) AS names(currency_code, currency_name, currency_order)), against_usd AS (SELECT upper(s.signal_code) AS currency_code, s.is_yes, s.band_code, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.lens_code = 'us_dollar' AND signal_code NOT IN ('summary', 'dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index')), against_aud AS (SELECT upper(s.signal_code) AS currency_code, s.is_yes, s.band_code, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.lens_code = 'australian_dollar' AND signal_code NOT IN ('summary', 'dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index')) SELECT n.currency_code, n.currency_name, u.measured_value AS value_in_usd, u.measured_value / u.threshold_value - 1 AS distance_usd, CASE u.is_yes WHEN true THEN 'Gaining' WHEN false THEN 'Losing' ELSE 'Base' END AS against_usd, coalesce(u.band_code, 'blue') AS band_usd, a.measured_value AS value_in_aud, a.measured_value / a.threshold_value - 1 AS distance_aud, CASE a.is_yes WHEN true THEN 'Gaining' WHEN false THEN 'Losing' ELSE 'Base' END AS against_aud, coalesce(a.band_code, 'blue') AS band_aud FROM names n LEFT JOIN against_usd u ON u.currency_code = n.currency_code LEFT JOIN against_aud a ON a.currency_code = n.currency_code ORDER BY n.currency_order

datasets.name: ds_currency_distance
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), names AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 1), ('EUR', 'Euro', 2), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 3), ('GBP', 'British pound', 4), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 5), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 6), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 7), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 8), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 9), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 10) AS names(currency_code, currency_name, currency_order)), against_usd AS (SELECT upper(s.signal_code) AS currency_code, s.is_yes, s.band_code, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.lens_code = 'us_dollar' AND signal_code NOT IN ('summary', 'dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index')), against_aud AS (SELECT upper(s.signal_code) AS currency_code, s.is_yes, s.band_code, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.monitor_code = 'currency' AND s.lens_code = 'australian_dollar' AND signal_code NOT IN ('summary', 'dollar_index', 'dollar_broad_index')) SELECT n.currency_name, n.currency_order, 'Against the US dollar' AS base_label, u.measured_value / u.threshold_value - 1 AS distance_ratio FROM names n JOIN against_usd u ON u.currency_code = n.currency_code UNION ALL SELECT n.currency_name, n.currency_order, 'Against the Australian dollar', a.measured_value / a.threshold_value - 1 FROM names n JOIN against_aud a ON a.currency_code = n.currency_code ORDER BY currency_order

'9999-12-31')), countries AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 'us_federal_funds_effective_rate', 'us_10_year_treasury_yield'), ('EUR', 'Euro', 'euro_area_deposit_facility_rate', 'euro_area_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 'japan_3_month_interbank_rate', 'japan_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('GBP', 'British pound', 'uk_call_money_rate', silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily i JOIN asof a ON i.indicator_date = a.day) SELECT c.currency_name AS country_currency, s.rate_value AS short_term_rate, s.observation_date AS c.long_rate_code = '-' THEN 'Not available' WHEN l.observation_date < add_months(a.day, -4) THEN 'Older than 4 months' END AS ten_year_note FROM countries c CROSS JOIN asof a LEFT JOIN latest s ON s.rate_code = c.short_rate_code LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.rate_code = c.long_rate_code

queryLines: WITH countries AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 'us_federal_funds_effective_rate', 'us_10_year_treasury_yield'), ('EUR', 'Euro', 'euro_area_deposit_facility_rate', 'euro_area_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 'japan_3_month_interbank_rate', 'japan_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('GBP', 'British pound', 'uk_call_money_rate', 'uk_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 'switzerland_3_month_interbank_rate', 'switzerland_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 'canada_3_month_interbank_rate', 'canada_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 'sweden_3_month_interbank_rate', 'sweden_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 'rba_cash_rate_target', 'australia_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 'new_zealand_3_month_interbank_rate', 'new_zealand_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 'china_3_month_interbank_rate', '-') AS countries(currency_code, currency_name, short_rate_code, long_rate_code)) SELECT i.indicator_date, CASE i.rate_code WHEN c.short_rate_code THEN 'Short-term rate' ELSE '10-year yield' END AS rate_label, i.rate_value FROM countries c JOIN silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily i ON i.rate_code IN (c.short_rate_code, c.long_rate_code) WHERE c.currency_code = :currency_code AND i.indicator_date >= add_months(date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()), -35) ORDER BY i.indicator_date

queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE monitor_code = 'currency' AND signal_code = 'summary' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), countries AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES ('USD', 'US dollar', 'us_federal_funds_effective_rate', 'us_10_year_treasury_yield'), ('EUR', 'Euro', 'euro_area_deposit_facility_rate', 'euro_area_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('JPY', 'Japanese yen', 'japan_3_month_interbank_rate', 'japan_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('GBP', 'British pound', 'uk_call_money_rate', 'uk_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CHF', 'Swiss franc', 'switzerland_3_month_interbank_rate', 'switzerland_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CAD', 'Canadian dollar', 'canada_3_month_interbank_rate', 'canada_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('SEK', 'Swedish krona', 'sweden_3_month_interbank_rate', 'sweden_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('AUD', 'Australian dollar', 'rba_cash_rate_target', 'australia_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('NZD', 'New Zealand dollar', 'new_zealand_3_month_interbank_rate', 'new_zealand_10_year_government_bond_yield'), ('CNY', 'Chinese yuan', 'china_3_month_interbank_rate', '-') AS countries(currency_code, currency_name, short_rate_code, long_rate_code)), series_values AS (SELECT rate_code, indicator_date, rate_value, two_hundred_day_average_value AS average_value, lag(rate_value, 252) OVER (PARTITION BY rate_code ORDER BY indicator_date) AS year_ago FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily WHERE rate_code LIKE concat('currency_value_%_in_', lower(:base_code))), today AS (SELECT v.* FROM series_values v JOIN asof a ON v.indicator_date = a.day), latest AS (SELECT i.rate_code, i.rate_value, i.observation_date FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_indicator_daily i JOIN asof a ON i.indicator_date = a.day), ranked AS ( SELECT c.currency_code, c.currency_name, s.rate_value AS short_term_rate, s.observation_date AS short_term_date, l.rate_value AS ten_year_yield, CASE WHEN c.currency_code = upper(:base_code) THEN 0 ELSE (t.rate_value / t.year_ago - 1) * 100 END AS currency_change_12m, CASE WHEN c.currency_code = upper(:base_code) THEN 0 ELSE (t.rate_value / t.average_value - 1) * 100 END AS distance_from_average FROM countries c LEFT JOIN latest s ON s.rate_code = c.short_rate_code LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.rate_code = c.long_rate_code LEFT JOIN today t ON t.rate_code = concat('currency_value_', lower(c.currency_code), '_in_', lower(:base_code)) WHERE s.rate_value IS NOT NULL AND (c.currency_code = upper(:base_code) OR t.year_ago IS NOT NULL)) SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY short_term_rate + currency_change_12m DESC) AS rank_position, currency_name, round(short_term_rate, 2) AS short_term_rate, short_term_date, round(ten_year_yield, 2) AS ten_year_yield, round(currency_change_12m, 1) AS currency_change_12m, round(distance_from_average, 1) AS distance_from_average, round(short_term_rate + currency_change_12m, 1) AS short_plus_12m FROM ranked ORDER BY rank_position

queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), m AS (SELECT m.*, c.company_name FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE c.company_name = :company_name), steps AS ( SELECT 1 AS step_number, 'Closing price' AS step_name, format_number(price_close, 2) || ' US$ on ' || CAST(price_date AS STRING) AS value_text, 'Latest close on or before the day' AS how_text FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Shares outstanding', format_number(share_count, 0) || ' (' || coalesce(share_count_source_code, 'none') || ')', 'From the latest filing' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Market value', format_number(market_value_amount / 1e9, 2) || ' US$ billion', 'Step 1 x step 2' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Earnings, trailing 12 months', format_number(earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount / 1e6, 1) || ' US$ million', 'Net income of the latest 12 months' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'P/E on trailing earnings (what finance sites show)', format_number(market_value_amount / nullif(earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount, 0), 2), 'Step 3 / step 4' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Earnings, average of the last ' || coalesce(CAST(earnings_year_count AS STRING), '0') || ' years', format_number(earnings_ten_year_average_amount / 1e6, 1) || ' US$ million', 'Average yearly net income, up to 10 years' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Inflation factor', format_number(consumer_price_index_value / nullif(filing_consumer_price_index_value, 0), 4), 'Price index today / price index at the filing' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'Average earnings in today''s money', format_number(earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_amount / 1e6, 1) || ' US$ million', 'Step 6 x step 7' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'P/E on 10-year inflation-adjusted earnings (the climate uses this)', format_number(price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio, 2), 'Step 3 / step 8' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 10, 'Index P/E without this member', format_number(price_earnings_without_member_ratio, 2), 'Same calculation over the other members' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'Effect on the index P/E', format_number(price_earnings_effect_ratio, 4), 'Index P/E minus step 10' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'Used in the index', CASE WHEN is_used THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No: ' || exclusion_reason_code END, 'A member is left out when an input is missing' FROM m) SELECT step_number, step_name, value_text, how_text FROM steps ORDER BY step_number

datasets.name: ds_company_price
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), listing AS (SELECT m.listing_id FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE c.company_name = :company_name), prices AS (SELECT p.price_date, p.price_close, p.price_high, p.price_low, avg(p.price_close) OVER w AS band_middle, stddev_pop(p.price_close) OVER w AS band_deviation, count(*) OVER w AS window_count, max(p.price_date) OVER () AS last_date FROM silver_domain_investments.price_daily p JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = p.listing_id WHERE p.price_date <= (SELECT day FROM asof) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY p.price_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT price_date, price_close, band_middle, band_middle + 2 * band_deviation AS band_upper, band_middle - 2 * band_deviation AS band_lower FROM prices WHERE window_count = 20 AND price_date >= CASE :range_code WHEN '5D' THEN date_sub(last_date, 7) WHEN '1M' THEN add_months(last_date, -1) WHEN '6M' THEN add_months(last_date, -6) WHEN 'YTD' THEN trunc(last_date, 'YEAR') ELSE add_months(last_date, -12) END ORDER BY price_date

datasets.name: ds_company_figures
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), listing AS (SELECT m.listing_id FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE c.company_name = :company_name), priced AS (SELECT p.price_date, p.price_close, i.price_high_fifty_two_week_amount AS high_52_weeks, i.price_low_fifty_two_week_amount AS low_52_weeks, lag(p.price_close) OVER (ORDER BY p.price_date) AS previous_close FROM silver_domain_investments.price_daily p JOIN silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily i ON i.listing_id = p.listing_id AND i.price_date = p.price_date JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = p.listing_id WHERE p.price_date <= (SELECT day FROM asof)) SELECT price_close AS last_close, price_close / previous_close - 1 AS day_change_ratio, high_52_weeks, low_52_weeks, price_date FROM priced ORDER BY price_date DESC LIMIT 1

datasets.name: ds_range_options
queryLines: SELECT * FROM VALUES ('5D', 1), ('1M', 2), ('6M', 3), ('YTD', 4), ('1Y', 5) AS t(range_code, range_order) ORDER BY range_order

# Currency Monitor

Is the dollar strong or weak, and which main currencies are gaining or losing against the US dollar and against the Australian dollar?

- A currency is gaining when its value is above its 200-day average
- The US Dollar Index (DXY) is the dollar's megatrend; the Federal Reserve's broad index covers about 26 currencies
- Each value is worked out from the US dollar rates: a Swiss franc in Australian dollars is the franc in US dollars divided by the Australian dollar in US dollars
- Interest rates: the short-term rate and the 10-year yield of each country, with the date of the reading

Change the date at the top. A dollar index above its average is a strong dollar (green: gaining), at or below it a weak dollar (red).

# Currency Deep Dive

Pick a currency: its value in US and Australian dollars against their 200-day averages, and the short-term rate and 10-year yield of its country when it has one.

lines:
# Yield Deep Dive

Which country would have paid the most, in your base currency? Each country is ranked by its short-term interest rate plus the change of its currency against the base over the last 12 months (252 trading days).

- Pick the base currency: the Australian dollar or the US dollar
- The currency change looks backward; it is not a forecast, and high-rate currencies often fall
- The rates are interbank or policy rates, not what a bank pays on a CD; the date of each reading is shown
- The base currency is shown with no currency change

frame.title: Base currency
Countries ranked by short-term rate plus 12-month currency change

# Company Deep Dive

Pick a company: its price first, then the steps that turn its filing and price into the P/E the climate uses.

- Step 5 is the trailing P/E finance sites show
- Step 9 is the one the climate uses; they differ when earnings were low in earlier years
- Bollinger bands: 20-day average of the close, plus and minus 2 standard deviations
